description: This file defines the API and data structures for accessing BDF-specific strings and properties within the FreeType font rendering library. It includes enums, structs, and function declarations related to BDF and PCF font properties.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Charset_ID
methods.description: Retrieves the charset ID, encoding, and registry of a BDF font face.

methods.name: FT_Get_BDF_Property
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property from a BDF or PCF font face.
